UnitStatement: Test module DEL-15-03 verifies the handoff export workflow.
FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS set bars authority terms (code compliant, certified, sealed, authenticated, professional approval, external validation, engineering acceptance) from export output.
validate_with_schema() checks a payload against a Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema and asserts zero validation errors.
provenance() builds a standard provenance record marking data as project-invented-test-data, machine_checked, invented_public_example.
checksum() builds a sha256 checksum record using JCS_compatible_json_payload_hash canonicalization.
handoff_package() constructs a canonical handoff package manifest (DEL-15-01) with model basis, units manifest, entity ids, refs, privacy, and professional boundary.

test_export_workflow_is_deterministic_and_preserves_required_context asserts canonical_json of two builds is equal and the export payload preserves model_hash, units, entity_ids, library/rule_pack refs, target mapping metadata, assumptions, and warnings.
test_unsupported_and_approximate_target_behavior_is_explicit asserts unsupported/approximate target records are present, all flagged human_review_required, and all carry affected_refs.
test_unit_bearing_mapping_without_unit_metadata_is_blocked asserts a mapping record without unit_metadata emits blocking diagnostic EXP-UNIT-METADATA-MISSING.

test_mapping_hash_and_units_mismatch_are_blocked_not_defaulted asserts model-hash and units-manifest mismatch emit EXP-MODEL-HASH-MISMATCH and EXP-UNITS-MANIFEST-MISMATCH rather than silently defaulting.
test_target_fixture_authority_metadata_is_blocking_boundary_diagnostic asserts prohibited authority terms in fixture metadata emit blocking EXP-PROHIBITED-AUTHORITY-TERM diagnostic.
test_export_output_contains_no_prohibited_authority_claims asserts the canonical export text contains no FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS and software_makes_compliance_claim is False.
Test module contract-checks the canonical handoff package JSON schema.
REQUIRED_ROOT defines required handoff-package root keys: schema_version, deliverable_id, package_id, scope_item, objectives, handoff_contract_status, handoff_package_manifest.
REQUIRED_DEFS enumerates required $defs of the handoff package schema (AnalysisRunRef, Checksum, Diagnostic, HandoffPackageManifest, Provenance, ProfessionalBoundary, etc.).
REQUIRED_DIAGNOSTIC_CLASSES enumerates handoff diagnostic classes including SOLVE_BLOCKING, RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING, EXPORT_BLOCKING, PRIVACY_WARNING, HASH_WARNING.
FORBIDDEN_STATUS bars HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT, CODE_COMPLIANT, CERTIFIED, SEALED, APPROVED from schema enums.
FORBIDDEN_SCHEMA_TEXT bars authority/approval phrases from schema text.
Handoff schema must declare $schema draft 2020-12, additionalProperties false, and contain no 'default' keyword anywhere.
Handoff schema constants pin deliverable_id DEL-15-01, package_id PKG-15, scope_item SOW-074, objective OBJ-017.
HandoffContractStatus consts bind record/manifest contracts and schema bindings (model, units, model_state, analysis_run, results, local_fea_handoff) with audit-hash predecessor semantics.
HandoffContractStatus reserves target_mapping_taxonomy for DEL-15-02, sets physical_package_container TBD, and external_prover_status not_declared_by_handoff_package.

HandoffPackageManifest requires package_identity, model_basis, model_hash, units_manifest, entity_ids, state/run/result refs, library/rule_pack refs, checksums, target_mapping_metadata, flags, assumptions, warnings, diagnostics, privacy, classifications, provenance, professional_boundary.
ModelBasis.model_schema const is schemas/model.schema.yaml.
Checksum requires algorithm, canonicalization, payload_ref, payload_scope, value; algorithm enum includes sha256/sha512/TBD; canonicalization enum includes JCS and JCS_compatible_json_payload_hash.
Checksum payload_scope enum covers manifest, model payload/hash, units, entity ids, state/run/result records, library/rule-pack metadata, local_fea handoff, audit manifest, external reference.
UnitsManifestRef requires unit_system_ref, units_schema, dimension_basis, and per-quantity unit fields; units_schema const is schemas/units.schema.yaml.
EntityIdManifest requires component/node/element/station/load_case/result/model_state/analysis_run id lists and mapping_id_refs.
LibraryRef requires provenance fields and private_payload_redacted const True; library_kind enum includes material, section, component, rule_pack, project_private, commercial_tool_reference.
RulePackRef requires id, version, checksum, source_notice, classifications, provenance, and private_payload_redacted const True.
PrivacyContext consts: local_only True, telemetry_allowed False, and private/protected/commercial payload-embedded all False.
PrivacyClassification enum includes public_metadata, invented_public_example, private_project/library/rule_pack data, commercial_tool_metadata, protected_suspected, redacted.
RedistributionStatus enum includes public_permissive, private_only, unknown, protected_suspected, commercial_tool_reference_only, invented_non_engineering_example.
ReviewClassification enum includes unreviewed, machine_checked, human_review_required, human_reviewed_reference_only, quarantined.

TargetMappingMetadata: mapping_schema_status const reserved_metadata_only, detailed_taxonomy_owner const DEL-15-02; target_system_kind enum includes local_fea, external_prover, commercial_tool_reference, generic_downstream_modeling, TBD.

UnsupportedBehaviorFlag behavior_label enum covers target-format/mesh/external-solver/external-prover/commercial-parser/physical-package/boundary-transfer/approximate behaviors; status enum unsupported/approximate/requires_human_review/not_implemented; human_review_required const True.
ProfessionalBoundary consts: human_review_required True; all compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication/professional-reliance claim flags False.
ProfessionalBoundary supports_downstream_modeling and supports_downstream_review consts are True.
Schema text must contain no FORBIDDEN_SCHEMA_TEXT and enums must be disjoint from FORBIDDEN_STATUS.

RequestedOutput enum includes result_envelope, audit_manifest, diagnostics.
HeadlessRunnerResult requires run_id, job, analysis_status, result_envelope_ref, result_refs, audit_manifest_ref, checksums, diagnostics, privacy, provenance, professional_boundary.
ResultEnvelopeRef consts: schema_ref schemas/results.schema.yaml, compatibility schema_first_json_result_envelope.
AnalysisStatus enum includes MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED and is disjoint from FORBIDDEN_STATUS.

ChecksumRef algorithm enum is exactly {sha256, sha512, TBD}; canonicalization enum is exactly {rfc8785_jcs, NONE, TBD}; result checksums minItems is 1.

Test module smoke-checks invented educational model examples.
EXAMPLE_FILES are mechanics_only_toy_span.json and fake_rule_pack_toy_model.json under examples/models/invented.
REQUIRED_PROJECT_KEYS for an invented project: id, name, unit_system, privacy_class, storage_policy, models, rule_pack_refs, report_settings, reports, diagnostics, hashes.

REQUIRED_MODEL_KEYS enumerate the full model record shape (nodes, elements, components, materials, sections, supports, load_cases, combinations, results, diagnostics, assumptions, traceability/design/constraint/operation/state/run/comparison/handoff/external refs, provenance).
REQUIRED_NOTICE_TEXT mandates invented examples carry 'invented', 'non-code', 'non-project', and 'not suitable for engineering reliance'.

FORBIDDEN_TEXT bars standards refs (ASME, B31, B31J), allowable/SIF/vendor terms, secrets/keys, commercial tool names (CAESAR, AutoPIPE, ROHR2), authority claims, and OPS synthetic protected markers from invented examples.

test_invented_examples_follow_model_contract_shape asserts schema_version 0.1.0, public privacy/storage, both physical_source_of_truth and analytical_solver_model roles present, exactly one physical model, and analytical models carry source_model_ref plus physical_to_analytical traceability link.
test_invented_examples_validate_against_full_model_schema validates each invented example against model.schema.yaml.

test_invented_examples_carry_concrete_hashes_for_published_payloads asserts one project hash with algorithm sha256, canonicalization JCS, value matching canonical-json sha256 of project-without-hashes, and rule_pack ref checksums equal the rule pack file digest.

test_invented_examples_persist_and_round_trip_with_schema_validation builds a project persistence envelope, validates it, and asserts canonical-json round trip is semantically equal with matching source/round-trip hashes and no diagnostics.
test_invented_examples_carry_non_reliance_notices asserts required non-reliance notice text is present and HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT is absent.
test_invented_examples_do_not_contain_protected_or_private_markers asserts no FORBIDDEN_TEXT markers appear.

test_fake_rule_example_links_only_invented_public_rule_pack asserts fake-rule example references exactly one rule pack INV_FAKE_RULE_PACK_REF with public_permissive redistribution and invented/engineering-acceptance-basis source notice.
Test module checks public/private library import provenance validation.
accepted_public_component_payload() builds a public-permissive-reviewed component library payload with accepted provenance and unit-bearing field values.
test_public_component_import_requires_accepted_public_provenance asserts an accepted public component import returns accepted True, outcome ACCEPTED_PUBLIC, no findings.
test_public_material_import_with_tbd_rights_is_rejected_for_review asserts public import of TBD-rights material is REJECTED with IMPORT_REDIS_RIGHTS_MISSING and IMPORT_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
test_private_material_import_can_remain_local_with_tbd_rights asserts private import of TBD-rights material is accepted as PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY without a redistribution-rights finding.
test_missing_provenance_blocks_import_without_defaults asserts deleting record provenance yields REJECTED with IMPORT_PROVENANCE_MISSING.
test_protected_suspected_metadata_quarantines_import asserts protected_suspected redistribution yields QUARANTINE with IMPORT_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED.
test_unit_metadata_is_preserved_for_imported_values asserts deleting a value unit yields REJECTED with IMPORT_UNIT_METADATA_MISSING.

test_import_findings_map_to_pkg02_diagnostic_envelope asserts findings map to a diagnostic with class import_boundary, source core.library_import.provenance_checker, affected_object ending .fields[0].value, remediation, and provenance source_name library_import_payload.

Local FEA handoff REQUIRED_DIAGNOSTIC_CLASSES include LOCAL_HANDOFF_BLOCKING, LOCAL_HANDOFF_WARNING, EXPORT_BLOCKING, IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING.

Test module stdlib-checks the material library schema.
CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS defines the allowed material dimension vocabulary (length, mass, stress, density, thermal_conductivity, second_moment_area, etc., plus TBD).
RETIRED_DIMENSIONS (temperature_difference, area_moment, conductivity, stiffness) must not appear in the schema.
Material schema REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL: schema_version, material_library, material_records, property_definitions, completeness_rules, diagnostics, open_decisions.
REQUIRED_MATERIAL_FIELDS: material_id, name, material_family, privacy_class, redistribution_status, properties, allowables, completeness, provenance, review_status.
REQUIRED_PROVENANCE_FIELDS: source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, review_status.
FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_DATA_TEXT bars ASME, B31, ASTM, CODE_COMPLIANT, certified material, sealed, automatic compliance, professional approval from material schema/fixture.
RedistributionStatus enum includes public_permissive, private_only, unknown, protected_suspected, rejected, TBD.
MaterialPropertyKind enum includes density, elastic_modulus, poisson_ratio, thermal_expansion_coefficient, allowable_stress, user_defined, TBD.
MaterialPropertyDimension enum must be a subset of CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS and disjoint from RETIRED_DIMENSIONS.

MaterialAllowableSlot requires allowable_id, allowable_kind, value_status, public_repository_value_policy, required_for, provenance, review_status; policy enum includes no_public_code_specific_values and private_user_supplied_only.
CompletenessRule requires rule_id, applies_to, required_property_kinds, required_for, missing_behavior, diagnostic_code, review_status; missing_behavior enum includes diagnostic_blocking.
MaterialDiagnosticCode enum includes MATERIAL_PROPERTY_MISSING, MATERIAL_UNIT_MISSING, MATERIAL_PROVENANCE_MISSING, MATERIAL_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED, MATERIAL_ALLOWABLE_NOT_PUBLIC.
OpenDecision topic enum includes public_material_fixture_policy, accepted_material_source_catalog, allowable_value_storage_policy, temperature_interpolation_policy.

Material fixture asserts library_scope public_schema_fixture, record redistribution_status TBD, allowable policy no_public_code_specific_values, completeness incomplete, diagnostic MATERIAL_PROPERTY_MISSING / SOLVE_BLOCKING.
Test module covers DEL-07-04 warning/blocking UX contracts.

build_warning_ux_contract test asserts deliverable_id DEL-07-04, auto_fill_missing_data False, blocking summary flags missing-support warning, analysis-boundary contract DEL-02-03 with USER_RULE_FAILED status, external-hash-bound human acceptance policy, professional boundary preserved, WARNING_SOURCE_STATUS_UNRESOLVED diagnostic, and no 'professional acceptance' text.
Test module stdlib-checks the structured model operation schema.
Model operation REQUIRED_ROOT keys: schema_version, deliverable_id, package_id, scope_item, objectives, operation_contract_status, operation_set.

Model operation REQUIRED_DEFS include ModelOperationRecord, OperationChange, OperationKind, OperationPrecondition, OperationSet, OperationValidation, OperationValuePayload, UnitRequirements, Quantity.
REQUIRED_OPERATION_KINDS: add, move, modify, delete, reconnect, constraint, load, support, design_knowledge.
FORBIDDEN_STATUS for operations bars agent_accepted_engineering_state, auto_approved, code_compliant, certified, sealed.
CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS list for operations includes force_per_length and the full canonical dimension vocabulary plus TBD.
Model operation schema consts: deliverable_id DEL-16-01, package_id PKG-16, scope_item SOW-069, objective OBJ-015.

OperationContractStatus consts: record_contract schema_first_model_operation_records, mutation_route structured_operations_only, direct_model_mutation_allowed False, user_acceptance_boundary downstream_user_acceptance_required, diff_preview binding DEL-16-02, audit_trail binding DEL-16-03.
OperationKind enum covers REQUIRED_OPERATION_KINDS; OperationAuthorType enum includes user, agent, import_adapter, project_template.
OperationStatus enum includes proposed, schema_validated, blocked_by_diagnostics, ready_for_user_review, rejected and is disjoint from FORBIDDEN_STATUS.
OperationSet requires operation_set_id, project_ref, model_ref, model_basis, operations, diagnostics, provenance, professional_boundary.
OperationModelBasis requires model_ref, canonical_model_role, physical_source_of_truth_ref, accepted_model_state_ref, accepted_model_state_hash; canonical_model_role const physical_source_of_truth.
ModelOperationRecord requires operation_id/kind/status, author_type, target_refs, preconditions, changes, validation, diagnostics, diff_preview_refs, assumptions, provenance, professional_boundary.
OperationPrecondition requires base_model_state_ref, required_current_hashes, required_refs, assumptions.

OperationChange requires change_id, change_kind, target_object_type, target_ref, value_payload, unit_requirements, provenance; change_kind enum includes add_object, remove_object, set_field, move_geometry, reconnect, update_constraint/load/support, attach_design_knowledge.

OperationValidation requires schema/constraint/unit validation, diff_preview_status, application_status; application_status enum includes not_applied, held_for_user_review, downstream_application_required.
UnitRequirements consts: unit_metadata_required True, dimension_check_required True, missing_unit_behavior emit_diagnostic; Quantity.dimension enum equals CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS.

Operation fixture asserts operation_kinds cover all required kinds, change_kinds cover all required change kinds, model_basis canonical_model_role physical_source_of_truth, and each operation has a model_state_record precondition hash.
Test module stdlib-checks the canonical domain model schema.

Model schema REQUIRED_DEFS include Project, Model, ModelRole, Node, Element, Component, Material, Section, Support, LoadCase, Combination, Result, Quantity, TraceabilityLink, and four typed load-record defs.
REQUIRED_ANALYSIS_STATUSES include MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT.
Model schema CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS list is the canonical dimension vocabulary including force_per_length and TBD.
check_schema_contract asserts draft 2020-12, additionalProperties False, no default keyword, required schema_version/project, and all REQUIRED_DEFS present.
AnalysisStatus enum must include REQUIRED_ANALYSIS_STATUSES but must not include CODE_COMPLIANT.
Model required fields include model_role and all child collections plus state/run/comparison/handoff/external refs and provenance.
ModelRole enum includes physical_source_of_truth, analytical_solver_model, derived_view, TBD.
TraceabilityLink trace_type enum includes physical_to_analytical, operation_application, state_snapshot, analysis_run, comparison, handoff, external_reference, TBD.

Reference object_type enum includes DesignKnowledge, Constraint, EquipmentInterface, ModelOperation, ModelState, AnalysisRun, Comparison, HandoffPackage, ExternalProverReference, Assumption, TraceabilityLink.
Quantity requires value, unit, dimension, provenance; dimension enum equals CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS and is disjoint from RETIRED_DIMENSIONS.
CoordinateSystem requires type and axes, allows y_reference and provenance, forbids local_x_axis; DirectionVector is fixed length 3 (minItems/maxItems 3).
Element schema requires const element_type straight_pipe and a y_reference orientation field.
Component component_type enum includes bend, elbow, branch, reducer, valve, flange, expansion_joint, rigid, specialty, other, TBD.

LoadRecord oneOf lists the four typed load records (NodalForce, NodalMoment, ElementPointForce, ElementUniformDistributedForce); each forbids additionalProperties and requires load_record_type, target_ref, direction, quantity, provenance with matching const types.
ForceDirection enum is [X,Y,Z]; MomentDirection enum is [RX,RY,RZ]; typed quantity dimensions pin force, moment, force_per_length, dimensionless; FractionQuantity value is bounded 0..1.

Support requires id, support_type, target_ref, directions, properties, provenance; Result requires diagnostics and provenance; Report requires input_manifest, hashes, analysis_statuses, diagnostics, rule_pack_refs, provenance_summary, professional_boundary_notice.

check_typed_load_records_and_orientation_validation validates four typed load records and a straight-pipe element, and asserts invalid moment direction, mismatched target, wrong dimension, out-of-range fraction, missing y_reference orientation, and forbidden local_x_axis are all rejected.
Test module covers DEL-14-03 model-state comparison.
entity() and state() helpers build invented model-state records (immutable read-only snapshot, JCS hashes, comparison_basis) and entities with stable_id, category, reference.
mapping_context() builds an explicit mapping context with manual-mapping evidence, hash refs, provenance, manual_reviewed confidence, and pending review.

test_stable_id_matching_is_order_independent_and_preserves_metadata asserts comparison output is order-independent (canonical_json equal), counts one changed/one unchanged, preserves note/external-reference metadata, and emits UNRESOLVED_STATE_ASSUMPTION.

test_added_removed_changed_unchanged_and_explicit_mapping_are_classified asserts summary counts (added/removed/changed/unchanged/mapped) and explicit_mapping match basis with MAPPING_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE diagnostic.
test_explicit_mapping_rows_preserve_evidence_hashes_and_provenance_context asserts mapped rows preserve mapping_id, evidence, hash_refs, provenance, review and emit no MAPPING_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE.
test_unresolved_mapping_and_unsupported_category_emit_diagnostics asserts unresolved mapping plus non-comparable category yield unresolved/added counts and MAPPING_UNRESOLVED diagnostic.
test_missing_mapping_target_is_unresolved_and_visible asserts a mapping to a missing right entity is unresolved and emits MAPPING_TARGET_MISSING.
test_incompatible_entity_categories_remain_unresolved asserts a Support-to-Load mapping is classified unresolved and emits UNSUPPORTED_CATEGORY.
test_unit_bearing_changes_require_unit_and_dimension_metadata asserts unit-bearing field changes without unit metadata are unresolved (not changed) with blocking MISSING_UNIT_METADATA diagnostic.
test_state_warnings_are_preserved_as_review_evidence asserts state warnings surface as STATE_WARNING_PRESERVED diagnostics carrying the warning ref and provenance.
test_output_boundary_language_does_not_make_prohibited_claims asserts comparison output text contains no prohibited claims and software_makes_compliance_claim is False.

Test module covers DEL-07-02 model tree/property inspector contracts.

build_model_tree_property_inspector test asserts order-independent canonical output, deliverable_id DEL-07-02, selection resolved, unresolved-TBD property validation_state, mutation_policy application_service_command_intents_only, no compliance claim, PROPERTY_VALUE_UNRESOLVED diagnostic, and no forbidden authority terms.
Test module covers DEL-17-03 native open JSON export packages.
FORBIDDEN_PAYLOAD_TEXT bars real-client, ASME-table, b31j, certified-by-openpipestress, code-compliant, professional-acceptance text from the export payload.
build_from_fixture() builds a native JSON export package from the fixture (source model ref/hash, model payload, stable id map, loss report, export profile, validation checks, privacy, provenance).
test_fixture_and_builder_validate_against_schema validates fixture and builder output against native_json_export.schema.json.

test_builder_is_deterministic_and_preserves_native_package_members asserts deterministic canonical output, DEL-17-03/PKG-17 ids, native_open_json target family, six member roles, seven sha256 checksums, exported loss categories, and no blocking diagnostics.

test_missing_units_stable_ids_and_loss_report_are_blocking_not_defaulted asserts empty units manifest and stable-id map emit blocking NJ-UNITS-MANIFEST-MISSING and NJ-STABLE-ID-MAP-MISSING, validation_status blocked, loss_report category TBD.

test_privacy_and_authority_boundary_diagnostics_block_public_package asserts prohibited authority term and embedded protected payload emit NJ-PROHIBITED-AUTHORITY-TERM and NJ-PRIVACY-BOUNDARY-VIOLATION, with no compliance or professional-reliance claim.
test_writer_uses_canonical_json asserts the writer output equals canonical_json(package) plus a trailing newline.
test_fixture_contains_no_private_or_protected_payload_text asserts the fixture contains no FORBIDDEN_PAYLOAD_TEXT.
Test module is a regression check for invented nonlinear support fixtures.
REQUIRED_FAMILIES of nonlinear fixtures: ActiveSet, Gap, LiftOff, Friction, NonConvergence.
REQUIRED_FIXTURE_NOTES map nonlinear fixture IDs (active-set, gap-closure, lift-off, friction, nonconvergence) to hand-calc markdown notes.

REQUIRED_UNIT_BASIS_LINES pin fixture-local unit basis: displacement/clearance mm length, reaction N force, rotational reaction N-m moment, friction coefficient ratio dimensionless, residual/iteration counts dimensionless.

BOUNDARY_PHRASES assert fixtures are project-original-public-content, invented support states, not copied from protected standards, commercial software, proprietary/private data, or real project records.
FORBIDDEN_TERMS bars ASME, B31, B31J, allowable-stress/SIF/vendor-catalog tables, secrets, certified, sealed, code-compliant, professional/licensed-engineer approval, professional reliance.
test_nonlinear_benchmark_crate_runs_focused_regressions runs 'cargo test --quiet' in the benchmark dir and asserts return code 0.

test_nonlinear_fixture_catalog_is_bounded_and_invented asserts all families and boundary phrases appear in source, units marker present, unit catalog TBD, all tolerance_policy assignments are None, and no forbidden terms appear.

test_nonlinear_fixture_notes_cover_each_public_original_fixture asserts each fixture note file exists and contains fixture id, source location, Provenance/Invented-Inputs/Expected-Values sections, README cross-links, and boundary phrases.

test_nonlinear_hand_calc_unit_basis_is_explicit_and_unresolved asserts required unit-basis lines, fixture-local basis marker, no project conversion constants, canonical unit catalog and release tolerances remain TBD, CI gate noted, and each note has Quantity/Canonical-dimension table with Tolerance policy TBD.
test_nonlinear_validation_artifacts_avoid_protected_and_claim_terms asserts no forbidden terms appear across source, READMEs, and fixture notes.
test_nonlinear_dimension_allowlist_includes_force_per_length asserts the Rust CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS allowlist includes force_per_length.
test_nonlinear_public_provenance_sources_exist_before_fixture_acceptance asserts every referenced hand-calc source location file exists on disk.
Test module covers DEL-16-03 user acceptance operation audit trail.
quantity_change() builds a set_field operation change with unit-bearing quantity payload (125 mm length) and unit requirements (metadata/dimension required, emit_diagnostic on missing).
operation_envelope() and assumption() helpers load the invented operation set fixture and prepare a ready-for-user-review op:resize operation with assumptions.
user_acceptance() and user_rejection() build explicit user decision signals (accept/reject) with actor, role, timestamp, rationale.

test_user_accepted_operation_record_is_deterministic_and_complete asserts deterministic canonical record, decision counts accepted=1, status accepted, explicit_user_acceptance True, accepted_model_state not mutated, affected entities, change history, generated diff preview, and unresolved assumptions preserved.

test_operation_cannot_be_accepted_without_explicit_user_signal asserts an agent acceptance signal yields held_for_user_acceptance with explicit_user_acceptance False and AUDIT-EXPLICIT-USER-ACCEPTANCE-REQUIRED diagnostic.
test_blocked_validation_outcome_prevents_accepted_record asserts a blocked validation (stale precondition hash) yields held_for_user_acceptance with AUDIT-VALIDATION-GATES-BLOCKING diagnostic.
test_current_model_state_hash_is_required_for_accepted_record asserts a missing accepted-state hash yields held_for_user_acceptance with AUDIT-MODEL-STATE-HASH-MISSING diagnostic.
test_rejected_operation_is_recorded_without_mutating_accepted_state asserts a rejection records status rejected, leaves accepted state unchanged, and reports decision counts rejected=1.
test_missing_inputs_are_visible_tbd_diagnostics asserts missing validation/preview/decision inputs surface AUDIT-*-TBD diagnostics rather than defaulting to acceptance.
test_output_boundary_language_does_not_make_prohibited_claims asserts audit output text makes no prohibited claims and software_makes_approval_claim is False.
Test module covers DEL-16-02 operation validation and diff preview.
operation_envelope() and quantity_change() helpers load the invented operation set fixture and isolate the op:resize operation change for preview testing.

test_valid_operation_generates_stable_preview_without_mutating_state asserts deterministic preview, unmutated accepted state, schema/unit validation passed, diff preview generated, application not_applied, and diff before/after diameter 100 to 125.
test_missing_unit_metadata_blocks_preview asserts a quantity without unit metadata emits OP-UNIT-METADATA-MISSING and blocks the diff preview.
test_unknown_dimension_blocks_unit_validation asserts an unknown dimension emits OP-UNIT-DIMENSION-UNKNOWN and blocks unit validation and diff preview.
test_force_per_length_dimension_is_accepted_in_quantity_payloads asserts force_per_length (N/m) passes unit validation with no unit diagnostics and generates the preview.
test_canonical_dimensions_match_accepted_pkg02_vocabulary asserts validation-preview, constraint-engine, and GUI CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS all match the units.schema DimensionId enum.

test_unresolved_target_and_constraint_findings_are_blocking asserts an unresolved target ref and blocking constraint diagnostic emit OP-TARGET-REF-UNRESOLVED and OP-CONSTRAINT-BLOCKING with constraint_validation blocked.
test_direct_mutation_request_is_rejected asserts an applied application_status request emits OP-DIRECT-MUTATION-BLOCKED and forces application_status not_applied.
test_schema_invalid_envelope_cannot_report_schema_passed asserts a schema-invalid envelope emits OP-SCHEMA-VALIDATION-FAILED and blocks schema validation and diff preview.
test_model_role_and_current_hash_are_required_before_preview asserts a non-physical model role plus stale current hash emit OP-ACCEPTED-STATE-MODEL-ROLE-BLOCKED and OP-CURRENT-HASH-MISMATCH.
test_output_boundary_language_does_not_make_prohibited_claims asserts validation-preview output makes no prohibited claims and software_makes_approval_claim is False.
